## skenv autostart

Run `skenv sync --quiet` at login and every hour

### Synopsis

Run `skenv sync --quiet` at login and every hour (macOS LaunchAgent
`com.qunaxis.skenv`, Linux systemd user timer). Log: `~/.local/state/skenv/autostart.log`.

```
skenv autostart [flags]
```

### Examples

```console
$ skenv autostart enable
$ skenv autostart status
$ skenv autostart disable
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for autostart
```
